status: primary dimensional source recovered; package assignment qualified

source.title: 1985 Sanyo Semiconductor Handbook - Transistors
source.copyright: Retained original manufacturer documentation; no assertion of a new open license.

original_project_photo.bom_description: 2SC536F TO-92 NPN transistor; 24 fitted parts; 536F marking
visual_findings: Photo is an unscaled approximately front-on image of a black package with a 536F marking.
Near-square visible body is consistent with 5 x 5 mm NP front face; a front image alone does not directly verify depth or rear curvature.
A preliminary SP interpretation from apparent side-edge lips was rejected after checking the source front aspect ratios.

dimensional_interpretation.source_dimensional_status: Typical where not explicitly min/max, per handbook printedpage40/PDF44. These are not maximum envelopes.
dimensional_interpretation.pin_view: Shown bottom/end view: B, C, E in that order along the lead line. The flat profile edge and viewpoint must be respected when mapping to PCB pads.
dimensional_interpretation.F_rank: hFE 160-320 in No333H; F is a gain rank and does not identify SP versus NP.

decision.proposed_model: Qualified historical Sanyo NP2003A illustration, using its primary typical dimensions; retain exact existing board pad geometry, model transforms, and installed lead-form qualifications.
decision.why_np_is_defensible: Original project BOM explicitly calls TO-92; No333H explicitly assigns TO-92 to NP2003A. Photo near-square frontal body is consistent with NP, whereas SP front drawing is4:3. This is a package-family selection, not exact fitted-vendor/mould authentication.
decision.sp_not_adopted: SP has a separate smaller rectangular4 x3 x2.2mm body and is not called TO-92 in No333H. An initial photo interpretation as SP was corrected before any geometry edit.
limits: No dimensional scale in project photograph.
Rear curvature and radii are drawn but not dimensioned.
Installed height, splayed lead bends and trimmed tails remain installation assumptions.
Factory1.3mm pitch must not replace existing PCB2.54mm/asymmetric2.54/3.302mm pad axes.
Existing electrical emitter/collector/base mapping must be independently preserved before integrating new models.
Do not present typical values as clearance maxima.

rejected_alternatives: Modern2SC536N/NPA-WA is not the recovered original package.
JSCJ and Semtech dimensions do not establish historical Sanyo536F geometry.
1968 round-case Sanyo scan is valid historical evidence but does not match the intended TO-92 family.
